title: Customer Portal Development Cost in India
seoTitle: Customer Portal Development Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What a B2B customer portal costs in India: orders, invoices, statements, documents, service requests, ERP integration. Cost bands, timelines and drivers.
summary: A customer portal for a B2B business in India typically costs ₹5 lakh to ₹12 lakh for order status, invoices, statements and documents connected to your ERP or Tally, ₹12 lakh to ₹30 lakh with online ordering, payments, service requests and multiple user roles per client, and more for complex multi-system portals.

costBands.includes: Order status, invoice and statement downloads, documents, WhatsApp links
Reorders, payments, service requests, client roles, account manager visibility
Several source systems, custom pricing, analytics for clients

dataPoints.label: Biggest cost driver
dataPoints.value: Reliable integration with ERP, Tally and document storage

dataPoints.label: Security
dataPoints.value: Each client sees only its own data; OTP or SSO log-in; audit logs

dataPoints.label: Adoption
dataPoints.value: Links sent in every invoice and dispatch message

dataPoints.label: Payback
dataPoints.value: Fewer routine calls and faster collections

body:
## What moves the price

- Number of source systems and data freshness.
- Online ordering with client-specific pricing.
- Payments and reconciliation.

See [customer portals: self-service without losing the relationship](/blog/customer-portals-self-service-for-clients-without-losing-the-relationship) and [building a client portal into your website](/blog/building-a-client-portal-into-your-website).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.a: Most do for routine needs when links arrive in messages they already get.

faqs.q: Can it show live stock and prices?
faqs.a: Yes, if the ERP data is reliable and the integration refreshes often enough.
